pages.title: Chip Away at an Ore
pages.text: $(item)Ore Chisel$() has five levels. Right-click a recognized ore with an enchanted pickaxe that can harvest that block to chip off rocks.$(br2)Each use costs durability and may destroy the ore without a second drop. Higher levels lower that chance and shorten the cooldown. It is incompatible with Silk Touch.

pages.title: Levels and Fortune
pages.text: The break chance is about 1/2 at level I and 1/6 at level V. Cooldowns for I–V are 20, 16, 12, 8 and 2 game ticks.$(br2)Fortune can add rocks, but also raises durability cost: $(thing)(10 − Chisel level) × (Fortune level + 1)$() per successful use. Chiseling is not an unlimited ore source.
